narrative.offerRewardText:
Here's your armor, adventurer. This will stand up to the strongest assaults or my name isn't Furen Longbeard!

And I have to thank you. I learned a lot while working with the materials

you brought me. I think I'll have another breakthrough one day!

I'm going to send what I learned to other

blacksmiths of the Alliance.

I'll tell them you were a big help, and maybe they'll want to return the favor.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 20 to 28, 7,600 XP in all.

quests.name: The Rethban Gauntlet
quests.objectiveText: Enter the Rethban Caverns, reach the first fork, and return to Yorus Barleybrew within the time allowed. You must not die and release your spirit.

quests.name: The Shieldsmith
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Cask of Scalder to Furen Longbeard.

quests.name: Fire Hardened Mail
quests.objectiveText: Gather the materials Furen Longbeard requires, and bring them to him in Stormwind.
